text: National Bank of Bahrain is 44.06% owned by Bahrain Mumtalakat Holding Company, wholly owned by the Bahraini government, and 10.85% by the Social Insurance Organisation; Bahrain Bourse lists Mumtalakat as holding the stake "on behalf of Bahrain Government".
short: State fund Mumtalakat holds ~44% of NBB "on behalf of Bahrain Government"

source.name: National Bank of Bahrain — Sustainable Finance Framework (December 2024)
source.quote: owned 45.09% by private and institutional shareholders, 44.06% Bahrain Mumtalakat Holding Company, wholly-owned by the Government of the Kingdom of Bahrain, and 10.85% by the Social Insurance Organisation
